status.empirical_route_cost: Empirical NavMesh route selected: polygons={polygons}, cost={cost}s.
status.empirical_route_unweighted: Empirical NavMesh weights unavailable; using geometric routing.
status.farm_started: Farming started; hold END to stop.
status.policy_contract_action_vocabulary: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact records {found} tactical actions, while this application uses {expected}. Train the artifact again on the current action contract.
status.policy_contract_goal_vocabulary: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact records the goal vocabulary {found}, while this application uses {expected}. Train the artifact again on the current vocabulary.
status.policy_contract_observation_schem: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact was trained on observation schema {found}, while this application encodes {expected}. Train the artifact again on the current schema.
status.policy_contract_observation_width: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact expects {found} observation columns, while this application encodes {expected}. Train the artifact again on the current observation.
status.policy_contract_reward_config: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact was rewarded with configuration {found}, while this application uses {expected}. Train the artifact again with the current reward configuration.
status.policy_contract_stamp_missing: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact states no decision contract, so it cannot be matched against the {expected} contract this application serves. Train the artifact again.
status.policy_contract_tactical_paramete: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact uses tactical parameter schema {found}, while this application requires {expected}. Train the artifact again instead of loading it.
status.policy_contract_version_mismatch: Learned automation halted: this policy artifact was produced under decision contract {found}, while this application serves {expected}. Train the artifact again instead of loading it.
status.policy_model_unavailable: Learned automation halted: {reason}. No learned decision is executed and the heuristic baseline does not silently take over.
status.quest_archive_skipped: Client archive {detail} could not be read and was skipped.
status.quest_script_skipped: Quest script {detail} is not packed in the client archives.
status.quest_table_skipped: Client table {detail} is missing, so some labels stay symbolic.
status.simulator_summary: Simulated {elapsed}s in {steps} steps: kills={kills}, KPM={kpm}, travel={travel}s, stalls={stalls}.
status.training_complete: Mob detector exported to {model}; labels written to {labels}
status.value_model_dataset_summary: Dataset: {count} training samples, {holdout} holdout samples, {sessions} sessions, split by {strategy}.
status.value_model_expected_cost: Mean expected farming cost on the holdout: {cost}.
status.value_model_head_skipped: Model {name} was not trained because the recorded data was insufficient: {reason}.
status.world_archive_block_skipped: {world}: the packed terrain block {detail} could not be decoded and was skipped
status.world_archive_index_skipped: {world}: the packed archive index of {detail} uses an unsupported layout and was skipped
status.world_extracted: {world}: {blocks} of {declared} terrain blocks, {zones} spawn zones, {obstacles} impassable areas -> {path}
status.world_object_file_skipped: {world}: the placed-object file {detail} uses an unsupported record layout and was skipped

ui.autopilot_reason_recovery_budget_exha: The configured recovery budget was exhausted.
ui.autopilot_reason_session_time_budget_: The configured session time budget expired.
ui.autopilot_reason_tick_fault_budget_ex: Too many session faults occurred within the configured window.
